scale: Coordinates are 1080x1920 pixels. Pixel films (540x960 grid) use the same numbers x 0.5; other 9:16 sizes scale by width/1080.

levels.ui: Platform interface covers it. Background only: no text, numbers, faces, logos, cards, CTA, key action, landing point, highlight or sound accent.
levels.captions: Reserved for the subtitles. Nothing else that must be read or seen.
levels.caution: Covered on some apps, phones, ads or long descriptions. Large shapes, object edges, floor and secondary detail are fine; no key text, numbers, faces, CTA or accents.
levels.edge: May be cropped on tall phones and under rounded corners. No text or faces; objects may bleed out intentionally.
levels.main: Safe for everything important: text, numbers, faces, hero objects, CTA cards, accents.
